title: Tate McRae Performs ‘Nobody’s Girl’ | Billboard Women In Music 2026
summary: Tate McRae performs “Nobody’s Girl” at Billboard’s Women In Music 2026. At the Hollywood Palladium on Wednesday night (April 29), Billboard Women in Music 2026 is honoring EJAE, REI AMI, AUDREY NUNA, Kehlani, Teyana Taylor, Ella Langley, Thalia, Zara Larsson, Laufey and Tate McRae.
